title: ModelDiff
description: The `data` payload of `dmtool model diff <baseFile> <headFile>` (MODEL-REVIEW-SPEC §5) — a STRUCTURAL diff of two models: it parses and binds both against their own workspace state, then compares structure, so a pure reformat is never reported. In two-file mode references resolve from side-specific `--base-workspace`/`--head-workspace`, shared `-w`, or each file's own folder; with `--since`, the base model and dependencies come from the Git ref while the head uses the working tree. `changes` lists every projected field, group, rule, computation, typedef, authored include/import, and model-configuration change with its per-aspect `deltas`. Field aspects cover declared/effective type, typed config, requiredness/messages, enum state, metadata, and flags; rule aspects cover condition, error entity, severity/code, localized messages, and metadata. Group aspects cover repeatability, index/sort declarations, mount alias/options, and metadata; child structure is reported as the actual child element changes, never duplicated as a group `children` delta. Typedefs carry their complete type/config/metadata; include/import entries carry purpose and reference and remain distinct from expanded content. CONFIG uses the stable id `model` and covers model identity/version, locales, decimal separator, time zone, condition language, short-name mode, supported characters, base year, labels, comment, annotations, and roles. The stable `before`/`after` strings preserve the original portable contract; additive `beforeValue`/`afterValue` objects expose natural scalar or string-list values without consumer parsing. For an ADDED element a delta carries only `after`/`afterValue`; for REMOVED, only `before`/`beforeValue`; for MODIFIED/REORDERED, both. Element ids are paths/full names, typedef ids, include/import aliases, or `model` for CONFIG.

changes.description: the element-level changes (fields, groups, rules, computations, typedefs, includes/imports, and model configuration) — base order, then head-only additions

element.description: the element family that changed (INCLUDE covers direct includes and type-definition imports; CONFIG is the single model-level configuration element)

id.description: the element's path/full name, typedef id, include/import alias, or the stable CONFIG id `model`

change.description: how the element changed between base and head (REORDERED = same element, different position within its parent; RENAMED/MOVED = a removed+added pair re-labelled as the same element relocated — RENAMED keeps its parent, MOVED keeps its leaf name; `id` is the base path, the `path` delta carries the new path)

risk.description: the change's review-impact tier under MODEL-REVIEW-SPEC §5b (the max over its reasons; loosening > tightening because a loosened/removed constraint can silently admit data that was previously rejected). This is consequence/triage severity, not probability or diff uncertainty.

riskReasons.description: the review-impact reason codes — a subset of the SPEC §5b taxonomy. HIGH (silently accepts bad data or affects active readers): RULE_REMOVED, POLARITY_INVERTED, REFERENCED_ELEMENT_REMOVED, RETYPE_AFFECTS_READERS, KIND_CHANGED, SEVERITY_DOWNGRADED, CONSTRAINT_LOOSENED. MEDIUM (fails loudly / undetermined direction): RULE_ADDED, COMPUTATION_CHANGED, GROUP_CHANGED, REPEATABILITY_CHANGED, TYPEDEF_ADDED/REMOVED, INCLUDE_CHANGED, CONFIG_CHANGED, LOCALE_REMOVED, TYPE_CHANGED, FIELD_CONFIG_CHANGED, CONSTRAINT_TIGHTENED, STRUCTURE_ADDED/REMOVED, PATTERN_CHANGED, SEVERITY_CHANGED, SCALE_CHANGED, CONDITION_RESTRUCTURED, REFERENCE_CHANGED, OPERATOR_CHANGED, THRESHOLD_CHANGED, CONDITION_CHANGED, ELEMENT_MOVED. LOW: LOCALE_ADDED, MESSAGE_CHANGED, CODE_CHANGED, METADATA_CHANGED, POSITION_CHANGED, ELEMENT_RENAMED.

partOfRefactor.description: present on a change folded into a refactor (the rename/move anchor, or a rewritten referrer) — the 0-based index into `refactors`; absent on a change that is not part of a refactor

deltas.description: the aspects that differ — every aspect for ADDED/REMOVED, only the differing ones for MODIFIED; a REORDERED element carries a single `position` delta (before/after = its 1-based index among its common siblings); a RENAMED/MOVED element carries a single `path` delta (before = base path, after = new path)

aspect.description: the aspect name (rule: condition/errorEntity/severity/code/message.<locale>/descriptions/annotations; field: declaredType/kind/typed config/requiredness/enum state/metadata/flags; computation: target/roundingMode/commonPrecondition/ordered alternative operation+precondition+tolerance/errorCodesToSuppress/message.<locale>/opaque; group: repeatability/index/sort/mount/metadata; typedef: declaredType/kind/typed config/metadata; include/import: purpose/reference; config: id/modelVersion/locales/decimalSeparator/timeZone/conditionLanguage/fieldRefByShortNameAllowed/supportedCharacters/baseYear/label.<locale>/comment/annotation.<name>/roles; a reorder: position; a rename/move: path)

before.description: the stable deterministic base-side rendering (absent when the element is ADDED); retained for compatibility and display

after.description: the stable deterministic head-side rendering (absent when the element is REMOVED); retained for compatibility and display

beforeValue.description: the typed base-side value (absent when `before` is absent)

afterValue.description: the typed head-side value (absent when `after` is absent)

conditionEdits.description: on a `condition` delta only — the LOCATED edit-script (MR1): WHICH clause/operand changed, a precise refinement over the coarse riskReason. And/Or chains are flattened and matched by content, so a clause inserted into a chain is one ADDED (a downstream clause is never mislocated) and a pure re-association is no edit; a genuinely ambiguous restructure degrades to the coarse kind for that region.

op.description: the node/subtree was added, removed, or replaced at this address

address.description: the breadcrumb of enclosing logic operators ("" at the root, "And", "And/Or") — stable under And/Or re-association, unlike raw left/right indices

nodeKind.description: the affected node's operator id ("?" for a degraded coarse region)

before.description: the base-side rendered subtree (absent for an ADDED clause)

after.description: the head-side rendered subtree (absent for a REMOVED clause)

summary.description: the human line (e.g. "threshold 1000→2000 on [Amount]", "added clause: FieldFilled(Approved)")

refactors.description: reference-rewriting refactors folded into ONE operation (MR4): each groups a rename/move with the referrers whose reference-delta is exactly that from→to repoint. A NON-DESTRUCTIVE overlay — the raw RENAMED/MOVED change and each rewritten referrer's MODIFIED change stay in `changes` (each carrying `partOfRefactor`), so the fold is verifiable from the change-set itself. Empty when the diff has no reference-rewriting refactor.

kind.description: RENAME (the element kept its parent, got a new name) or MOVE (it kept its leaf name, got a new parent)

referrers.description: the rules whose reference to `from` was rewritten to `to` (their raw MODIFIED changes remain in `changes`)

deltaValue.description: A delta value with a closed type tag. Unsupported or deliberately textual aspects use TEXT, so every rendered value has a typed envelope.
